our_interpretation: Building one's own Salesforce means developing an internal replacement for the Salesforce functions a company uses. It does not require copying every Salesforce product.
A working internal replacement counts; a demonstration or announced intention alone does not.
The causal claim has separate components: absence of actual replacements, influence on stock prices, and an explanation involving pro-AI bias.
I assess the narrative and relevant events preceding June 23, 2026. No precise starting date is supplied.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence supports the absence of substantive internal replacements and links the narrative's adoption and stock-price effects to pro-AI bias rather than demonstrated replacement activity.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A documented substantive internal replacement contradicts the categorical absence claim. Evidence of actual product developments or other identifiable causes also challenges the assertion that the market reaction lacked a factual basis.
